title: Marvel's Spider-Man Eternal: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Spider-Man wouldn't hesitate to save others, and neither will I!"
"You know, we should really do this more often." —Spider-Man, Peter Parker
"Will they? Won't they? Find out next time, on the season finale of *Secret Hospital.*"
"Heroes save people. It's what we do."
No opinions, no sick days, and no qualms about collateral damage—just the way Alchemax likes it.
"Knowledge of the future can be a burden, but I'm not one to be weighed down."
"I'm a 22nd century Lyrate Life-form Approximation. I already know what you need before you do."
"Lyla, did it work? Are we in the Heroic Age?"
An ancient terror from beyond the stars now awakens to ravage the world.
The Life Foundation captured Venom and extracted seeds for newborn symbiotes. Symbiotes they could not control.
Eddie Brock's prayers for vengeance were answered by a darkness from another world.
"Keep up, Spider-Man. We don't have all night!" —Ghost-Spider, Gwen Stacy
"No, it's fine. I'm late for practice again, but sure, I have time for a runaway bus."
"You gotta FACE IT TIGER! FACE IT TIGER!" —"Face It Tiger"
"I just . . . just . . . wanted to be special . . . like you, Gwen." —Lizard, Peter Parker (Earth-65)
"I made my choices, Miles, good and bad. Now you need to make yours."
Miles released his anger, his frustration, and his stored up bio-electricity.
